messages.subject: Mediation: account/correct for variables
parts:
Dear all, 

I have a fairly straightforward question regarding correction of a model: is it possible to account/correct for a certain variable; in this case baseline memory in a model with memory slope as outcome; and if so, is this code the correct approach to do so ?
I added it as a direct effect 'c2'.

Many thanks in advance !

model_age_hippvol <- 
' # direct effect
memory_slope ~ c1*Age + c2*baseline_memory
# mediator
Total_hippocampus ~ a*Age
 memory_slope   ~ b*Total_hippocampus
# indirect effect (a*b)
   ab := a*b
 # total effect
 total1 := c1 + (a*b)
 total2 := c2 + (a*b)'

fit <- sem(model_age_hippvol, data = Dataset_n179, test="bootstrap") 
summary(fit, standardized=T, fit.measures=T, rsq=T)

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Mediation: account/correct for variables
parts: I added it as a direct effect 'c2'.

I would also add it as a predictor of the mediator, so that the "a" path and "b" path both have the same interpretation that it is the effect, controlling for baseline_memory.  That way, the indirect effect unambiguously has that interpretation too.

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
